messages:
cory_sales: Hey team, Acme (enterprise) sent back the SIG v2 PDF and wants question-by-question attachments for Q12–Q15. They need artifacts by COB Friday. Can we split?

toni_se: I can own Q12 (logical tenancy/data separation) + Q15 (network segmentation). Will need the tenancy diagram and a short config snippet.

nate_security: I'll take Q13 (KMS & key rotation) and Q14 (encryption in transit/rest). I have a draft rotation policy we can reference.

emma_ps: I have the SOC2 excerpt and our dataflow narrative that usually helps. Uploading the diagram and the snippet in a sec.

deploybot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/tenancy_diagram_v2.pdf|tenancy_diagram_v2.pdf> (size: 842KB)

toni_se: Got it, thanks. Quick check — for the config snippet do we want example `nginx` config or `envoy` for the segmentation example? Acme uses Envoy.

cory_sales: Envoy please. Also customer asked for a redacted tenant-config example showing per-tenant ACLs and a short line about how we isolate KV caches. Keep it high-level.

toni_se: Pasted a small example below (will sanitize before sending):
```yaml
# per-tenant routing example (sanitized)
virtual_hosts:
  - name: tenant-abc
    routes:
      - match: /tenant/abc/*
        cluster: rwinf-tenant-abc
```

toni_se: Will redact hostnames, then push to /shared/sales-acme/attachments.

nate_security: For KMS, use the rotation policy doc `kms-rotation-2025.md` and cite our HSM-backed KMS integration. I'll attach the policy excerpt and a short justification paragraph for the SIG answer.

nate_security: Also: note about customer-managed keys — Acme asked if we support BYOK in VPC/private. Short answer: yes, in Private mode with KMS integration + network controls. I'll draft one-liner.

emma_ps: Uploaded SOC2 excerpt and dataflow narrative: <https://files.redwood.internal/soc2_section.pdf|soc2_section.pdf>, <https://files.redwood.internal/dataflow_redwood_acme.md|dataflow_redwood_acme.md>

cory_sales: This is great. Two asks before I send: 1) can each of you drop the final artifact filenames here when ready, and 2) a 1–2 sentence plain-English summary we can paste into the SIG answer for non-security reviewers?

toni_se: Filenames: `/shared/sales-acme/tenancy_diagram_redacted.pdf`, `/shared/sales-acme/envoy_tenant_snippet.yaml`

toni_se: Plain English: "Requests are routed and isolated by tenant at the proxy layer; per-tenant routes map to dedicated runtime clusters and caches to prevent cross-tenant access."

nate_security: Filenames: `/shared/sales-acme/kms_rotation_excerpt.md`, `/shared/sales-acme/byok_support_note.txt`

nate_security: Plain English: "Encryption keys are managed in an HSM-backed KMS with scheduled rotations; Private deployments support customer-managed keys (BYOK) integrated via KMS APIs."

emma_ps: Filenames: `/shared/sales-acme/soc2_excerpt.pdf`, `/shared/sales-acme/dataflow_narrative.md`

cory_sales: Perfect. I'll assemble and run a final pass for redactions and grammar. Targeting to send to Acme by 17:00 PT Friday. Thanks all :thumbsup:
